about_the_game:
FEEL INDIA

Venture into the untouched depths of Northeastern India, where a forgotten forest whispers with ancient secrets. From abandoned tribal settlements to sacred natural spaces, explore a world lost to time—shrouded in fog, silence, and stories untold. Feel the weight of every step through immersive soundscapes, dynamic lighting, and environmental storytelling.

AWAKEN THE MOTHER

Journey through a land where the Panch Tatvas, the Five Elements of Nature— Prithvi (Earth), Jal (Water), Vaayu (Air), Aakash (Space), and Agni (Fire) have begun to fade. Solve cryptic puzzles, decode forgotten mantras, and restore balance to a dying forest. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth… and deeper into the forest’s secrets

FACE WHAT IS WITHIN

Lurking in every corner of the forest is a vikar (vice) born from Kaliyug (The Era of Darkness in Hinduism)—Kaam (Lust), Krodh (Anger), Lobh (Greed), Moh (Attachment), Mad (Ego), and Irsha (Envy). These aren’t monsters. They’re reflections of humanity at its worst, told through psychological horror, atmospheric storytelling, and real social commentary. Confront not just what’s around you—but what’s within.

THINK

Navigate through natural mazes, decode riddles that challenge your mind, answer questions which unlock doors for you, solve puzzles, find ways and at last try to escape which you won't be able to

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 4GB / AMD RX 570 4GB
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with surround support
  • VR Support: Not Supported

short_description: Explore a forgotten forest steeped in Indian culture. Solve ancient puzzles, awaken the Nature, and confront your inner demon, your Kaliyug, in a haunting, story-driven psychological experience
